latest_action.text: Read the second time. Placed on Senate Legislative Calendar under General Orders. Calendar No. 424.

card.summary: The Prevent Government Shutdowns Act of 2026 provides automatic temporary funding for federal programs, projects, and activities if regular appropriations bills are not enacted before a new fiscal year begins. It provides funding in 14-day increments at the rate of operations from the prior fiscal year. It also restricts official travel, campaign fund usage for official travel, and congressional recesses, and limits the consideration of unrelated legislation for members of Congress and certain federal employees during periods of automatic continuing appropriations.
card.title: Prevent Government Shutdowns Act of 2026

latest_action.text: Ordered to be Reported (Amended) by the Yeas and Nays: 39 - 1.

card.summary: The Prevent Government Shutdowns Act automatically provides temporary funding to prevent government shutdowns if regular appropriations bills are not enacted before a new fiscal year begins. During this funding lapse, the bill restricts official travel and campaign funds for official travel by Members of Congress and certain federal employees, limits legislative business and recesses in Congress, and requires daily quorum calls.
card.title: Prevent Government Shutdowns Act
